summary: This is a Markdown document with two section headers that have custom attributes. Each header has an anchor ID (like #intro and #chapter1) and a data attribute that sets a custom menu title different from the displayed heading text.

explanations.1: The highlight-next-line comment tells a documentation tool (like Docusaurus) to visually highlight the immediately following line.
explanations.2: The {#intro data-menu-title="Introduction"} syntax adds an anchor ID so this section can be linked to, and specifies what text should appear in the navigation menu instead of the full heading.
explanations.4: Same highlighting instruction as line 1, preparing the next section header for visual emphasis.
explanations.5: Similar to line 2, this creates an anchor point and tells the menu system to display 'Chapter 1' in navigation instead of the longer heading text.
